page_title: Google Labs: Google's home for AI experiments

summary.name: Google Labs
summary.one_liner: Google Labs' collection page listing its AI experiments, from experimental game creation and research tools to coding agents and learning apps.
use_cases: Trying experimental AI tools before they become products
Creating a custom game from a text description
Building apps or websites with AI coding assistance
summary.what_it_does: This page is a index of Google Labs AI experiments, each with a short description and a link to try it, learn more, or join a waitlist. Listed experiments include Playground (describe a game and get a custom game), Literature Insights and Hypothesis Generation for research, Jules as an asynchronous coding agent, Stax for AI model evaluation, and Learn Your Way for AI-driven learning. It also lists products that graduated from the labs, such as Gemini (formerly Bard), Google Flow (formerly VideoFX), Gemini Notebook (formerly Project Tailwind), Google Flow Music (formerly ProducerAI), and Google AI Studio (formerly MakerSuite). The page itself gives no pricing details, so availability of each tool is not stated here.
notable: Lists many Google AI experiments in one place, some of which later became full products
Playground lets users create and share games by describing them, with no coding
Several tools are for research, such as Literature Insights and Hypothesis Generation
caveats: Experiments are early-stage and may change or be discontinued
Some entries require joining a waitlist for access
Pricing and regional availability are not stated on the page
